description: Explicit research-gap closures. A gap may be marked closed only when the referenced Evidence Decisions map to the Topic and at least one referenced protocol is present in the trusted protocol feed for the same Topic.

entries.rationale: Memory moved from an ontology growth gap to active coverage after Brali reviewed current evidence on wakeful rest and retrieval practice, narrowed unsupported transfer claims, and published trusted protocols that preserve those evidence boundaries.

Revision & Feedback moved from a growth gap to active coverage after Brali reviewed a 2024 meta-analysis of educational writing feedback, replaced inherited unsupported peer-review claims with a bounded protocol that distinguishes surface and deep revision targets, mapped that protocol to the canonical Topic, and preserved explicit limits on learner population, feedback source, sequence, and transfer beyond educational writing.
